description: GAC Reservations v1 — a mobile-first, auth-gated room/hall booking system for Gawargious & Ava Antonious. Members browse room schedules, check availability, and submit booking requests; admins approve/reject from a queue. Next.js 15 (App Router) + TypeScript + Tailwind + shadcn/ui, backed by Supabase (Postgres, Auth, RLS) via supabase-js and raw SQL migrations.

userStories.title: SQL migration for rooms, bookings, and profiles tables
userStories.description: As a developer, I need the core schema so bookings can be stored.
acceptanceCriteria: Version-controlled SQL migration file creates rooms (id, name, capacity, amenities, location, rules, created_at)

Creates profiles (id FK auth.users, display_name, role default 'member', created_at)
bookings.status constrained to 'pending' | 'approved' | 'rejected' | 'cancelled' via enum or CHECK

userStories.notes: Added supabase/migrations/20260719000000_create_core_schema.sql creating booking_status enum, rooms, profiles, and bookings (with FKs to auth.users, end_time>start_time check, and room/date + user_id indexes). Typecheck passes (no TS changes; SQL-only story).

userStories.title: SQL migration for Row-Level Security policies
userStories.description: As a developer, I need RLS so data access is enforced at the database layer, not just the UI.
acceptanceCriteria: RLS enabled on rooms, bookings, and profiles
rooms: any authenticated user may SELECT; no member INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE
bookings: members SELECT/UPDATE only their own rows; INSERT only where user_id = auth.uid() and status = 'pending'; only role='admin' may set status to 'approved'/'rejected'
profiles: a user may read/update only their own profile; role is not self-service editable
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Added supabase/migrations/20260719000100_add_rls_policies.sql: enables RLS on rooms/bookings/profiles; rooms readable by any authenticated user with no member write policies; bookings select/insert/update scoped to user_id = auth.uid() with insert requiring status='pending' and member updates blocked from setting approved/rejected; a security-definer is_admin() plus an admin-only update policy lets only role='admin' transition status to approved/rejected; profiles select/update scoped to own id, with a BEFORE UPDATE trigger blocking role self-edits unless done via the service_role key. Typecheck passes (SQL-only story, no TS changes).

userStories.title: Session gating middleware and admin route guard
userStories.description: As a member, I want every page to require login, and admin pages to reject non-admins.

userStories.notes: Added middleware.ts + lib/supabase/middleware.ts (session refresh, redirects unauthenticated users to /login for all routes except /login and /signup, and redirects authenticated users away from those two). Added app/admin/layout.tsx (server-side role check against profiles, redirects non-admins to /) and a placeholder app/admin/page.tsx for US-013 to fill in later. Also fixed a real blocking bug found while verifying this: the US-004 RLS migration enabled RLS and added policies but never granted base table privileges to the authenticated role, so every RLS-permitted query still failed with 'permission denied for table' — added supabase/migrations/20260719000300_grant_table_privileges.sql (select on rooms; select/update on profiles; select/insert/update on bookings). Verified end-to-end via Playwright against a fresh `supabase db reset`: unauthenticated hits to / and /admin both redirect to /login; a freshly signed-up member reaches / but is bounced from /admin back to /; the seeded admin account reaches /admin and sees its placeholder heading. npx tsc --noEmit and npm run lint both pass.

userStories.description: As a developer, I need one overlap-check function reused across availability, request, approval, and edit.
acceptanceCriteria: Function detects overlap as same room_id and date with start_time < existing.end_time AND end_time > existing.start_time
Considers only bookings in status 'approved' or 'pending'
Exposed as a single reusable module imported by other features
Typecheck passes
Tests pass
userStories.notes: Added lib/bookings/conflict-check.ts exposing findConflictingBookings/hasConflict (pure overlap logic over room_id+date+start/end time, filtered to pending/approved, with an excludeBookingId option for edit-in-place re-checks) plus fetchConflictingBookings, a Supabase-backed wrapper that queries bookings for the candidate room/date and runs them through the same pure function — the single implementation future stories (US-011/012/013/015) will import. First story needing a test runner, so added vitest (vitest.config.ts, npm run test) and lib/bookings/conflict-check.test.ts covering overlap, containment, boundary-touching (non-overlap), different room/date, non-conflicting statuses, and the exclude-id case. npx tsc --noEmit, npm run lint, and npm run test all pass (10/10 tests).

acceptanceCriteria: Schedule page defaults to a calendar view with a toggle to a list view
Filter controls for room and for date/date-range; selecting a room shows only that room's bookings
pending and approved bookings are visually distinguished (e.g. amber vs green badge)

userStories.notes: Added supabase/migrations/20260719000400_add_bookings_schedule_view.sql: a security-invoker=false view (public.bookings_schedule) exposing only id/room_id/date/start_time/end_time/status for pending+approved bookings, granted to authenticated — needed because the existing bookings RLS policy only allows a member to read their own rows, but the schedule must show everyone's slots without leaking user_id/notes/service. Added app/schedule/page.tsx (server component, fetches rooms) + components/schedule/schedule-view.tsx (client component: room select + From/To date inputs, Calendar/List tabs via shadcn Tabs, day-grouped cards in calendar view vs a flat sorted list in list view, amber/green BookingStatusBadge). Added shadcn badge/select/tabs components and lib/dates.ts (local-timezone date helpers). Linked from the home page. Verified with Playwright against the local Supabase instance: signed up a fresh member, confirmed calendar view groups seeded bookings by day with correct amber/green badges, list view shows the same bookings flat, room filter narrows correctly (fixed a bug where the Select showed the raw room id instead of its name), no member email/identity appears anywhere, and 375px viewport has zero horizontal overflow (scrollWidth === clientWidth). npx tsc --noEmit, npm run lint, and npm run test (10/10) all pass.

userStories.title: Check room availability search
userStories.description: As a member, I want to search by date/time range to find which rooms are free.
acceptanceCriteria: Search form with date, start time, end time, and optional capacity filter
Results list rooms available for the requested slot using the shared conflict-check utility
A room with an overlapping approved booking is excluded from results
A room with an overlapping pending booking is shown as 'Requested — pending approval'
Empty-state message when no rooms are available for the slot
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill
userStories.notes: Added app/availability/page.tsx (server component, fetches rooms with capacity/location) + components/availability/availability-search.tsx (client component: date/start-time/end-time/optional-capacity search form). On search it queries the bookings_schedule view (already scoped to pending/approved, no identity/notes) for the chosen date, then runs the shared findConflictingBookings util per room to decide inclusion: rooms with an overlapping approved booking are excluded, rooms with only an overlapping pending booking are shown with a 'Requested — pending approval' badge, and rooms with no conflict are shown as 'Available'; capacity filter drops rooms with null/insufficient capacity. Linked from home page and schedule page nav. Verified end-to-end with a Playwright script against local Supabase (db reset + two seeded bookings — one approved, one pending): approved-conflict room excluded, pending-conflict room shown with the pending badge, unaffected rooms shown available, capacity filter narrows correctly, empty-state message shows when no rooms qualify, a non-overlapping time slot shows the previously-excluded room as available again, and 375px viewport has zero horizontal overflow. npx tsc --noEmit, npm run lint, and npm run test (10/10) all pass.

userStories.title: Request a room/hall
userStories.description: As a member, I want to request a room for a date/time and service so an admin can review it.
acceptanceCriteria: Form fields: room, date, start time, end time, service/purpose (fixed dropdown constant), optional notes
Client-side conflict check warns before submit if the slot overlaps an approved or pending booking
Server-side conflict check re-validates before insert and blocks conflicts with no row written
Server-side check rejects the request if the member already holds 5 open pending requests
A valid request inserts a bookings row with status 'pending' linked to the user, then redirects/confirms to View My Bookings
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill
userStories.notes: Added app/bookings/new (form: room/date/start/end/service-dropdown/notes) + app/bookings/actions.ts requestBooking server action + app/bookings (minimal 'My bookings' flat list, the redirect/confirm target — US-016 will expand it into tabbed buckets) + lib/bookings/services.ts (fixed BOOKING_SERVICES constant per PRD FR-9). components/bookings/request-form.tsx runs a client-side conflict check against bookings_schedule on field change (non-blocking amber warning); requestBooking re-checks conflicts server-side via fetchConflictingBookings and blocks insert with no row written, and separately blocks if the member already has 5 open pending bookings. Fixed two real bugs found while verifying: (1) lib/bookings/conflict-check.ts's fetchConflictingBookings queried the base `bookings` table, which RLS restricts to the caller's own rows, so it silently missed other members' conflicting bookings — switched it to query the `bookings_schedule` view (already exposed to all authenticated members for pending/approved room/time/status) so conflict checks actually see everyone's bookings; (2) neither the new form nor the action normalized `<input type="time">`'s "HH:MM" to Postgres's "HH:MM:SS" before comparing/storing, causing false-positive conflicts on adjacent (non-overlapping) slots — added lib/dates.ts#normalizeTimeString and applied it in both the client-side check and the server action. Verified end-to-end with Playwright against a fresh `supabase db reset`: valid request inserts and redirects to /bookings showing Pending; a duplicate-slot request shows the client-side pending-overlap warning then is blocked server-side with zero extra rows written; a slot overlapping a separately-inserted approved booking is also blocked; filling 5 pending requests succeeds and a 6th is rejected with the 5-pending-cap message and no 6th row written; adjacent non-overlapping slots (e.g. 10:00-11:00 right after an existing 09:00-10:00) are correctly allowed; 375px viewport has zero horizontal overflow. npx tsc --noEmit, npm run lint, and npm run test (10/10) all pass.

userStories.title: Admin approval queue
userStories.description: As an admin, I want to approve or reject pending requests so schedules stay conflict-free.
acceptanceCriteria: Admin-only route lists all pending requests (room, requester, date/time, service)
Approve sets status to 'approved'; reject sets status to 'rejected' and stores an optional reason
On approve, a fresh server-side conflict check runs and blocks approval if a conflict now exists
Approving one of two pending requests for the same slot prevents the other from being approved
Non-admins cannot reach the route or invoke its actions (server-side + RLS)
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill
userStories.notes: Added app/admin/page.tsx (lists pending bookings with room/requester/date-time/service/notes, sorted by date+start_time) + app/admin/actions.ts (approveBooking/rejectBooking server actions, each re-checking admin role server-side via requireAdmin() before mutating). Added supabase/migrations/20260719000500_add_admin_select_policies.sql (admin-only select policies on bookings/profiles via is_admin(), since the existing select policies only let a user read their own rows) and supabase/migrations/20260719000600_grant_service_role_table_privileges.sql (service_role lacked base table grants entirely — same class of bug as US-007's authenticated-grant fix — so any server-side use of the service-role client 403'd; not on the approval queue's own path, but a real gap worth closing). Found and fixed a real bug in lib/bookings/conflict-check.ts: fetchConflictingBookings' approval re-check reused the default pending+approved status filter, so two pending requests for the same slot always blocked the FIRST approval too (the sibling still-pending request looked like a conflict). Added an optional `statuses` param (default unchanged) and had approveBooking pass `['approved']` only, matching the PRD's description of the approval re-check as a race guard against another already-approved booking. Verified end-to-end with a Playwright script against a fresh `supabase db reset` (two members, two directly-seeded overlapping pending bookings simulating the race scenario, one admin): non-admin redirected from /admin, admin sees both pending cards with room/service and no raw email leak, approving the first succeeds, approving the still-pending conflicting sibling is blocked with a clear conflict error and leaves it pending, rejecting it with a reason stores the reason, and each member's own /bookings page reflects the final approved/rejected status. npx tsc --noEmit, npm run lint, and npm run test (10/10) all pass.

userStories.title: Cancel a booking
userStories.description: As a member, I want to cancel my own booking so the slot frees up.
acceptanceCriteria: Cancel action available for pending and future approved bookings owned by the user
Cancelling sets status to 'cancelled' after a confirmation step
Cancel action is not available for past bookings
A cancelled slot immediately shows as available in schedule and availability views
A user cannot cancel another user's booking (enforced via RLS)
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill
userStories.notes: Added components/bookings/cancel-booking-button.tsx (shadcn alert-dialog confirmation) and app/bookings/actions.ts#cancelBooking, wired into app/bookings/page.tsx for bookings that are pending/approved and not past (lib/dates.ts#isBookingPast). cancelBooking re-verifies ownership/status/not-past server-side before updating status to 'cancelled'; RLS's existing bookings_update_own policy (user_id = auth.uid(), status not in approved/rejected) independently blocks cross-user cancellation and self-approval bypass. No new migration needed: bookings_schedule and the conflict-check utility already filter to pending/approved only, so a cancelled booking is immediately excluded from schedule/availability views and conflict checks. Verified end-to-end with a Playwright + supabase-js script against a fresh `supabase db reset`: a future pending and a future approved booking both show a Cancel button and cancel successfully after confirming the dialog; a past approved booking shows no Cancel button and is left untouched; after cancelling, bookings_schedule no longer returns either id; a second user's own signed-in client attempting to update the first user's booking is blocked with 0 rows affected. npx tsc --noEmit, npm run lint, and npm run test (10/10) all pass.

userStories.title: Modify/reschedule a booking
userStories.description: As a member, I want to change the date/time/room of my request without recreating it.
acceptanceCriteria: Edit action available for pending and future approved bookings owned by the user
Editing date, time, or room reverts status to 'pending' and re-runs the conflict check
A modification conflicting with another approved or pending booking is blocked with a clear error
A previously approved booking that is edited requires re-approval by an admin
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill
userStories.notes: Added app/bookings/[id]/edit/page.tsx (server component: loads booking, verifies ownership + isBookingModifiable, redirects to /bookings?error=... otherwise, passes rooms + booking to the form) + components/bookings/edit-booking-form.tsx (client form pre-filled with current values, room/date/start/end/service/notes fields, client-side conflict-check warning via bookings_schedule + findConflictingBookings excluding the booking's own id) + app/bookings/actions.ts#updateBooking server action (re-verifies ownership/modifiability, re-runs fetchConflictingBookings excluding the booking id and blocks with a clear error on conflict, sets status back to 'pending' if room/date/start/end changed from the stored values, otherwise leaves status unchanged, then redirects to /bookings). Added lib/bookings/status.ts#isBookingModifiable (shared pending/approved-and-not-past check) and reused it from both app/bookings/page.tsx (replacing its local isCancellable) and the new edit page, and added an Edit link/button next to Cancel on modifiable rows in app/bookings/page.tsx. Verified end-to-end with a Playwright + supabase-js script against a fresh `supabase db reset`: edit form pre-fills correctly; rescheduling an approved booking into a slot conflicting with another user's pending booking is blocked with a clear inline error and leaves the original booking untouched; rescheduling into a free slot succeeds, reverts status to 'pending', and updates the stored time; navigating directly to a past booking's edit URL redirects away; a second user cannot reach the first user's edit page (redirected). Also confirmed zero horizontal overflow at 375px. npx tsc --noEmit, npm run lint, and npm run test (10/10) all pass.

userStories.title: View my bookings
userStories.description: As a member, I want to see my upcoming, pending, past, and cancelled bookings in one place.
acceptanceCriteria: Tabbed or filterable list with buckets: Upcoming / Pending / Past / Cancelled
Bookings are bucketed correctly by date and status
Each row links to a detail view exposing cancel/edit actions where applicable
Only the logged-in user's own bookings are returned (enforced via Supabase RLS, not just UI filtering)
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill
userStories.notes: Rewrote app/bookings/page.tsx into a shadcn Tabs view (Upcoming/Pending/Past/Cancelled, each with a live count) with rows now linking to a new app/bookings/[id]/page.tsx detail view instead of exposing Edit/Cancel inline. Added lib/bookings/status.ts#bucketForBooking: cancelled and rejected bookings are always terminal (never 'upcoming'), everything else moves to 'past' once its end time has elapsed regardless of status, otherwise pending/approved map to their matching bucket. Upcoming/Pending sort soonest-first, Past/Cancelled sort most-recent-first. The detail page fetches the single booking (RLS's existing bookings_select_own policy already scopes it to the caller, so a foreign id 404s via redirect), shows date/time/service/notes/reject_reason (rejected only), and reuses isBookingModifiable + CancelBookingButton/Edit link, matching US-014/015's existing modifiability rules. Verified end-to-end with a Playwright + supabase-js script against a fresh `supabase db reset`: seeded one user with 4 bookings (approved future, pending future, approved past, cancelled future) plus a second user's booking in the same room set; tab counts read Upcoming(1)/Pending(1)/Past(1)/Cancelled(1) with the correct booking in each and the second user's booking not appearing anywhere (RLS-enforced, not just UI filtering); clicking into the upcoming (approved, future) booking's detail page shows Edit + Cancel; clicking into the past booking's detail page shows neither; 375px viewport has zero horizontal overflow. npx tsc --noEmit, npm run lint, and npm run test (10/10) all pass.
